description: This file contains an extension for CanvasWindowController that implements WKNavigationDelegate methods to handle navigation actions within a WKWebView, including scheme-based decision logic and interactions with NSWorkspace.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A class representing the window controller for the Canvas view, extended here to handle web navigation.

methods.name: webView(_:decidePolicyFor:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles decision-making for navigation actions, including custom deep link handling, allowing certain URL schemes, and opening external URLs with registered applications.

methods.name: webView(_:didFinish:)
methods.description: Called when a web view finishes navigation; triggers debug status updates.
